The bounded [Kapoor phosphate-glass increment](experimental/material-batches/kapoor-phosphate-glasses-20261024/INTEGRATION.md) adds six study-qualified analyzed calcium phosphate/aluminophosphate formulations with one as-prepared density each. ICP-OES oxide compositions are not nominal recipes. The source-wide SD ceiling is not six individual SDs, and repeated measurements do not establish independent specimen counts. Compressed states and calculated properties are excluded.

### Kapoor 2019 calcium phosphate/aluminophosphate glass facts

Saurabh Kapoor, Randall E. Youngman, Lina Ma, Nadja Lönnroth,
Sylwester J. Rzoska, Michal Bockowski, Lars R. Jensen, Mathieu Bauchy and
Morten M. Smedskjaer (2019), *Permanent Densification of Calcium
Aluminophosphate Glasses*, Frontiers in Materials 6:63,
[DOI 10.3389/fmats.2019.00063](https://doi.org/10.3389/fmats.2019.00063).
Copyright 2019 by the listed authors. The article-specific notice on
publisher PDF page 13 and the publisher HTML copyright link identify the
[Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International license](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).

Changes are transcription of six selected Table 1 density cells and analyzed
ICP-OES oxide compositions, with supporting preparation/method facts and
original structured scope qualifications. The reported compositions are not
nominal recipes or independently certified final stoichiometries. These are
as-prepared, annealed/reannealed glass states; compressed variants and
calculated molar volumes or packing densities are excluded. The source-wide
SD bound is not assigned as individual row SDs. Repeated measurements do not
establish independent specimen counts, and missing conditions remain unknown.
No separate restriction was observed on the selected table or method; this
review does not import referenced works or separately credited content.
No author or publisher endorsement is implied. The source PDF, screenshots,
full text and raw measurements are not distributed or relicensed under MIT.

def regression_checkpoint_bytes(relative):
    """Recover only a frozen Tarasov resource for historical regression assertions.

    Execution paths never opt into this view. Successor helpers must first
    validate the actual current graph or file; immutable Git bytes are only
    the final equality check, never a fallback for unknown current content.
    """
    data_paths = {'materials_boundaries/data/' + name for name in RESOURCE_HASHES}
    allowed = data_paths | {
        '.github/workflows/ci.yml',
        'experimental/platform/query-service/materials_query/pins/legacy_baseline.json',
    }
    require(type(relative) is str and relative in allowed,
            'Unknown Tarasov regression checkpoint resource')
    import material_append_successors as successors
    require(Path(successors.__file__).resolve() == (ROOT / 'tests/material_append_successors.py').resolve(),
            'Historical recovery must use the checkout test-only successor registry')
    path = ROOT / relative
    require(not path.is_symlink() and path.is_file() and path.resolve().is_relative_to(ROOT.resolve()),
            'Historical regression resource must be a regular repository file')
    raw = path.read_bytes()
    if relative in data_paths:
        raw = successors.project_successor_catalog_bytes(
            Path(relative).name, raw, before=TARASOV_BATCH_ID)
    else:
        raw = successors.project_successor_file(relative, raw, before=TARASOV_BATCH_ID)
    require(raw == git('show', REGRESSION_CHECKPOINT + ':' + relative),
            'Unreviewed Tarasov regression checkpoint successor: ' + relative)
    return raw
